title: On the role of relaxation and acceleration in the non-overlapping Schwarz alternating method for coupling
summary: The purpose of this paper is to study the influence of relaxation and acceleration techniques on the convergence behavior of the non-overlapping Schwarz algorithm with alternating Dirichlet-Neumann transmission conditions in the context of domain decomposition- (DD-) based coupling. After demonstrating that the multiplicative Schwarz scheme can be formulated as a fixed-point iteration, we explore, both theoretically and numerically, two promising techniques for speeding up the method: (i) Aitken acceleration and (ii) Anderson acceleration.
